India news: Modi heads to ASEAN meet in Manila
November 16, 2026
Modi is also likely to attend the Quad leaders' summit involving the US, Japan and Australia on the sidelines of the ASEAN meet in Manila.
What you need to know
- The three main issues on ASEAN's agenda include maritime security, economic cooperation and development partnership
- The building collapse in Delhi's Paharganj area has left eight people injured
Here is a roundup of headlines from India on Monday (November 16):
Indian PM Modi to attend ASEAN summit in Manila today
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to leave for Manila, in the Philippines, to attend the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)-India summit and the 21st East Asia Summit.
The ASEAN meeting will focus on three main issues: maritime security, economic cooperation and development partnership.
According to the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), the Prime Minister will attend a dinner hosted by Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on November 16 before participating in the India-ASEAN Summit and the East Asia Summit process on November 17.
During his two-day visit to Manila, Modi is also likely to meet US President Donald Trump, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese as the leaders of the Quad group meet on the sidelines of the ASEAN summit.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio had indicated last month that the Quad meeting was planned alongside the wider meetings in the Philippines.
Announcing his visit to Manila, PM Modi said in a post on X, "Will be in Manila, Philippines later today and tomorrow to attend the following programmes: 23rd ASEAN-India Summit. 21st East Asia Summit."
Welcome to our coverage
Hello! This is Midhat from DW's New Delhi bureau, bringing you the latest news from across India.
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is heading to the Philippines to attend the ASEAN summit, on the sidelines of which he will also attend a Quad leaders' summit.
In the Indian capital, a building collapse has left several people injured.
Meanwhile, in the south, the Sabarimala temple is opening for the annual Mandala pilgrimage season.
Stay tuned as we bring you more from India throughout the day!

במהלך הביקור בן יומיים, מודי צפוי להשתתף בארוחת ערב בהארחת נשיא הפיליפינים פרדיננד מרקוס הג'וניור. כמו כן, הוא צפוי לפגוש בשולי הכנס את נשיא ארצות הברית דונלד טראמפ, ראש ממשלת יפן סאנאה טאקאיצ'י וראש ממשלת אסטרליה אנתוני אלבניז, במסגרת פגישת מנהיגי קבוצת הקוואד.
